events.title: Camper lighting, portable batteries and a flashlight
events.summary: Thanks for your feedback during Steam Next Fest. This update adds more ways to light your camp and fixes several problems with setting up and moving equipment. Camper and camp lighting Added two adjustable worklights on the camper, with switches on the light heads and indicators showing when they have power. The roof and side sockets use the same camper power system. Solar panels and connected battery banks provide power through actual cable connections. Additional panels can increase charging,

events.title: Demo fixes: water, shops and transport
events.summary: Thanks for your reports during Steam Next Fest. Here is a combined changelog for the latest three demo updates. Water and equipment Fixed canister filling of the settling basins, including empty basins. Pouring keeps its free aiming direction. Fixed interaction with water hose connectors at the caravan and filling station. Empty, disconnected wash-tray modules can be packed independently. Partially dismantled setups retain the remaining modules and connections when loaded. Increased tap filling

events.title: Demo Update: Friends Co-op, Shared Tutorial & Personal Gold
events.summary: Find your place in the goldfields Play with friends in the Windows and macOS demos, with co-op for up to four players and illustrated quest cards for the shared tutorial. Choose a male or female character, then customize their appearance and colours. Guests start with personal tools and a consistent hotbar. Bills and loans stay with the host; each guest keeps a saved personal wallet. Take personal nuggets and gold jars from the Journal to drop or trade; the detector finds dropped gold and sales

events.title: Demo Update: Your First Claim, Better Transport & Illustrated Fieldbook
events.summary: A bigger start to your goldfields adventure The Windows demo has received a substantial update ahead of Steam Next Fest. Thank you to everyone who has played and shared feedback! Continue beyond the guided introduction: choose a claim, move your equipment and start your first independent shift. Clearer claim maps, boundaries, navigation and payment information. A new animated Outback main menu, a compact HUD and cleaner quest instructions. Illustrated fieldbook pages explain the small wash plant
